correctness.rationale: For any face with selected outer-edge blocks T, |T|>=3 forces a 3-matching, while |T|<=1 is precisely the full spoke simplex U joined to disjoint edges L. For |T|=2, possible spokes and outer edges form exactly Y_i*Y_j where Y_i is the three-edge path p_i-q_i-r_i-s_i; these are closed 3-balls, their intersections with the contractible core A=U*L are exactly their entire 2-sphere boundaries, and any distinct ball intersections lie in A. Thus quotienting by the nonempty contractible CW subcomplex A gives wedge of one 3-sphere per unordered block pair, universally in m. A relative integral three-cycle is the oriented join of path fundamental chains, and swapping two 1-dimensional factors contributes (-1)^4=+1, while a path reflection contributes -1, yielding the stated signed permutation action. Independent exhaustive direct forbidden three-matching face checks for m=1..4 found 16/137/715/3478 faces and verified local balls/core; bounded experiments confirm, not prove, the general construction.
